description: Annual country-level development indicators: population, income, health, connectivity, energy access, prices and labour market.

coverage.temporal: Annual values of the current and the six preceding years (as far as published)

updateCadence.upstream: Quarterly WDI releases with ad-hoc revisions

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0)
license.notes: A small number of WDI series carry third-party restrictions; the indicators used here are CC BY 4.0.

limitations: Annual statistics published with a lag of one to three years; the most recent year is frequently missing for some countries.
Values are national aggregates and hide sub-national variation.
Several series are modelled estimates (e.g. ILO unemployment, UN IGME mortality) rather than direct measurements.
The API intermittently answers individual indicator requests with HTTP 502 or stalls; a failed indicator is retried and the source is shown as delayed (partially refreshed) meanwhile.
confidenceNotes: No per-value confidence is published. Official statistics compiled by the World Bank from national and international sources; treat the latest year as provisional.

retention.note: Annual values of the last seven years are requested; values are purged 8 years after their reference year.

layers.name: GDP per capita
layers.description: Gross domestic product per person, current US dollars.

layers.name: Under-5 mortality
layers.description: Deaths of children under five per 1,000 live births (UN IGME estimate).

layers.name: Internet users
layers.description: Individuals using the Internet as a share of the population (ITU).

layers.name: Access to electricity
layers.description: Share of the population with access to electricity.

layers.name: Unemployment
layers.description: Unemployment as a share of the labour force (modelled ILO estimate).
